note: Eve's retrievable knowledge. A fact is offered to the model only when one of its `triggers` appears as a word in the event's title or notes. Triggers are matched exactly (lowercased, whole words), NOT semantically — an earlier embedding-based version matched everything to everything and produced meeting advice for a Sleep event. Keep triggers specific: a word that shows up in unrelated event titles will drag its facts along with it. Keep each text under ~20 words; every retrieved line spends part of a 4096-token window.

facts.text: A gym session usually needs workout clothes, a towel, a water bottle, and shoes to change into.
People often forget a change of clothes when going to the gym straight from work or class.
Swimming needs goggles, a towel, and a dry change of clothes.
An outdoor run usually needs running shoes, and sunscreen or a cap in daytime heat.
A meeting usually needs a laptop, a charger, and any document or note the discussion is about.
An online meeting needs a working link, headphones, and a quiet place to sit.
A presentation needs slides available offline, a charger, and an adapter for the room's display.
An interview usually needs an offline copy of your CV, the address, and the interviewer's name.
A class or lecture usually needs a notebook or laptop, a charger, and any assignment that is due.
An exam usually needs an ID card, pens, and any calculator or material the exam allows.
A doctor or clinic visit usually needs an insurance or ID card and a list of current medication.
A dental appointment usually needs your insurance card and a note of any tooth pain to mention.
Medication is easiest to remember when tied to a fixed daily event like a meal.
A flight needs a passport or ID, the booking reference, and time for check-in before departure.
Trips are commonly ruined by a forgotten phone charger or power bank.
A train or bus journey needs the ticket saved offline in case there is no signal at the station.
Hotel checkout is usually late morning, earlier than most people expect.
Riding a motorbike needs a helmet, and a rain jacket if rain is likely.
Some parking attendants and small vendors still take cash only.
A grocery trip works better with a list written before leaving, and a reusable bag.
Cooking a planned meal needs its ingredients checked at home first — one missing item blocks the dish.
Laundry needs to be hung or collected the same day, especially in humid weather.
Leaving a pet alone for a day needs food, water, and someone to check on them.
A vet visit needs a carrier for the animal and its vaccination record.
A birthday or celebration usually needs a gift or card arranged in advance.
A restaurant meal with several people usually needs a booking made ahead.
